_doc: REDMAIN-1 (2026-11-20): a deploy gate that is red on main is repaired by code, not by a model and not by a person. On 2026-11-19 a swept branch changed one character in site/webbotauth.js; checks did not run the site tests, the merge went green, and the site did not deploy for 29 hours while the code agent failed to fix it. Consumers: foundation/redmain.py (--run in .github/workflows/ciwatch.yml, --check in tests/foundation/test_redmain.py).
